title: Skytech Infinite Platform IPO Details
intro:
Skytech Infinite Platform IPO is a book build issue of ₹22.68 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 0.29 crore shares of ₹22.68 crore.

Skytech Infinite Platform IPO bidding opened for subscription on Aug 14, 2026 and will close on Aug 18, 2026. The allotment for the Skytech Infinite Platform IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 19, 2026. Skytech Infinite Platform IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 21, 2026.

Skytech Infinite Platform IPO is set issue price band at ₹73 to ₹77 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,46,400 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,69,600.

Finshore Management Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Integrated Registry Management Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Prabhat Financial Services Ltd.

Refer to Skytech Infinite Platform IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2009, Skytech Infinite Platform Limited is engaged in providing turnkey industrial automation solutions, covering design, engineering, supply, installation & commissioning (I&C), and maintenance of a wide range of control panels.

The company specializes in manufacturing automation control panels that integrate PLCs, drive systems, switchgear, and sensors to enhance process efficiency and operational performance. Its panels function as centralized systems for managing and monitoring industrial machinery, ensuring improved reliability and productivity.

Skytech Infinite Platform serves diverse industries including power, water, energy, machine tools, infrastructure, motor management, food & beverages, HVAC, chemicals & pharmaceuticals, automotive, and process industries.

Its product portfolio includes PCC panels, APFC panels, MCC panels, VFD panels, PLC panels, and control desk panels. The company is an authorized partner of Mitsubishi Electric India Private Limited, Endress + Hauser (India) Private Limited, Exor India Pvt. Ltd., and Euroteck Environmental (P) Limited.
As of March 31, 2026, the company has a workforce of 87 employees. Its registered office, factory, and warehouse are located in Bangalore, Karnataka.

faqs.question: How to apply in Skytech Infinite Platform IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Skytech Infinite Platform IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Skytech Infinite Platform IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Skytech Infinite Platform IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Skytech Infinite Platform IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: Skytech Infinite Platform IPO lot size is 1600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,46,400 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Skytech Infinite Platform IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Skytech Infinite Platform IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Skytech Infinite Platform IPO will be done on Wednesday, August 19, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Aug 20, 2026 . Check the Skytech Infinite Platform IPO allotment status .
